gemini-cli-gallery.note: Verified live 2026-09-10. The Gemini CLI extension gallery discovers a public repo from the topic gemini-cli-extension plus a gemini-extension.json at the repo root, and crawls daily. There is NO submission step at all: no form, no pull request, no queue, no account, no review. That is unique among the 48 surfaces recorded here. Shipped on 30 of 32 mirrors, generated per server by scripts/mirror-seo.py so a sync reproduces it. Verified by reading the live repos back: 30 valid manifests with the topic set, 2 correctly absent. delivery-schedule and office-suite are the two: their hosted endpoints return 404, and a manifest that breaks on first use is worse than none. The manifest declares httpUrl plus an Authorization Bearer token declared in settings; a stdio command was rejected because a fresh clone has no dist directory. Whether the crawler has actually indexed us is NOT yet known, check on or after 2026-09-11.
